answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in garden, checked in jade, and jetty exposes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 19 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1692 identities would post 1715 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
